Name: Lumisteria Custom Set of Oak Furniture
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: A custom set of oak furniture matching some vanilla ones.
Description:
See my CP version at : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26505

This mod adds around 60 new furnitures inspired by vanilla ones.

The set added use oak wood and green color, and will contains items such as a piano, artistic furniture, bookcases, painting and decorative items and more.

You'll need [Custom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254)  for this set to work.

***
Consider using my[Interior recolor](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/361)  mod for matching bed and kitchen.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

 ***

Note : the Custom Furniture mod may have some issues, like some items randomly becoming other items. The issue isn't on my side and i have no control on it.

***
